summary: Frontend-only retest of /pricing card price visibility fix. Fix works at 1440x900 desktop but STILL FAILS at 1280 (xl) and 1024 (lg) breakpoints — Scale 'Custom' text and Pro '£1,500' text overflow their card content area. Count-up animation, badge, tablet/mobile layouts, and prior regressions are OK.

ui_bugs.issue: At 1024x900 (lg 4-col layout), Pro £1,500 overflows card content by 13px and Scale 'Custom' overflows by 40px. Font-size lg:text-5xl (48px) is still too large for the 150px inner content width (card 214px - 64px padding).
At 1280x900 (xl breakpoint), Scale 'Custom' overflows content by 6px (needs 220px, has 214px). Pro £1,500 fits with only 14px breathing room (user required >=15px).

detailed_measurements.method: Measured via scrollWidth of price glyphs (unclipped by overflow-hidden) vs inner card content width (innerRect.width - paddingLeft - paddingRight). Breathing room = contentWidth - requiredWidth.

viewport_1024x900.pro_1500: req=163, br=-13px OVERFLOW (scrollWidth 143 vs clientWidth 148 — text is clipped by overflow-hidden)
viewport_1024x900.scale_Custom: req=190, br=-40px OVERFLOW (scrollWidth 190 vs clientWidth 148 — text clipped)
viewport_1024x900.verdict: FAIL at 1024 (lg breakpoint, exactly the reported case)

count_up_animation.note: Count-up animates 0 → 1,500 as expected. useCountUp hook works.

regression_checks.most_popular_badge_visible_above_growth: PASS at 1440/1280/1024/820/390 (badge y-position measurable and above card top or half-inset per design)
regression_checks.cta_buttons_present_and_aligned: PASS (verified in prior iteration_2, no regression from font-size-only change)

action_items: Reduce lg:text-5xl (48px) further for numeric prices AND Custom text OR reduce £ prefix and switch to a smaller size at lg. Suggested: at lg breakpoint use ~text-[36px]-text-[40px] so 'Custom' width fits 150px content and '£1,500' fits with 15+px breathing room. Anton at 40px: '1,500' ≈ 120px + £ prefix ~20px = 140px, fits 150px with 10px br — still tight, may need to also relax card padding at lg (currently p-8 = 32px). Consider lg:p-6 (24px) which would give 166px content — then 48px price with 40-50px br works.
Alternative: at lg breakpoint set price to text-[42px] and set 'Custom' to text-[38px] AND reduce card lg padding to lg:p-6 (24px). Then Pro fits with ~35px br and Custom fits with ~40px br.
At xl (1280): reduce xl:text-[60px] to xl:text-[52px] for numeric (so £1,500 ≈ 152 + 20 = 172 < 214 content) and xl:text-[48px] for 'Custom' (≈188 < 214). Provides >=25px breathing room.
Re-run the same measurement script after fix to verify breathing room >= 15px at every breakpoint for every price.
critical_code_review_comments: PricingCards.jsx line 25 and 35: font-size responsive scale insufficient at lg and xl breakpoints when 4-column layout produces narrow ~214px cards. The main agent's calculation for available space was over-optimistic — 'Anton character widths narrower than typical' does not fully compensate; measured widths: '1,500' at 60px Anton = 176px; 'Custom' at 56px Anton = 220px; both exceed content width at 1024-1280 4-col layouts.
Root cause is not just font-size — the card padding (p-7 sm:p-8 = 28-32px each side) also eats into narrow columns at lg. Consider lg:p-6 to yield more room without shrinking type as aggressively.

Suggest also whitespace-nowrap prevents wrap but does NOT prevent overflow — overflow-hidden on parent inner card silently clips visible text (why user could still see the bug). Consider adding a runtime CSS test or Storybook visual regression.
No file exceeds 700 lines; overall code quality remains good.

success_rate.frontend: 40% (2/5 viewports fail requested criteria for Pro/Scale price visibility)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Use scrollWidth (NOT getBoundingClientRect) to measure real text width — overflow-hidden on inner card silently clips the visible bounding box, so bounding-box based checks give false positives. Content width = innerRect.width - paddingLeft - paddingRight. Requirement per problem statement: text end must have >=15px gap from content right edge. Check at 1440/1280/1024/820/390 viewports, focus on Pro £1,500 and Scale Custom. Font family is Anton (condensed).
rca_of_the_issue: The main agent's fix (lg:text-5xl xl:text-[60px] for numeric, lg:text-5xl xl:text-[56px] for Custom) reduces font size but not enough. At 1024px viewport, the 4-col grid produces ~214px card widths. With p-8 (32px each side), content width is only ~150px. At lg:text-5xl (48px Anton), '1,500' renders 143px wide and 'Custom' renders 190px wide — both plus £ prefix (for Pro) exceed the 150px content area. Similarly at 1280 xl breakpoint, xl:text-[56px] Custom renders 220px vs 214px content width. Reproduction: open /pricing at 1024x900 or 1280x900 and observe Scale card — 'Custom' extends past right edge of card (clipped by parent overflow-hidden). Mitigation: further reduce font sizes at lg and xl breakpoints, or additionally reduce lg card padding from p-8 to p-6.
